zh.title: 澳洲航空預計10月24日結束墨爾本至洛杉磯空中巴士A380航班
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，澳洲航空預計於10月24日執行墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士 A380 航班，隨後該航線將選用波音 787-9 機型營運。根據歷史紀錄，波音 787-9 在 2026 年引領廣體客機交付量，相關交付也正加速四家航空公司旗下三款舊型客機的退役進程。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 的新聞報導，澳洲航空預計於10月24日執飛由墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士 A380 客機航班。
在停止空中巴士 A380 於該條路線的飛航服務後，澳洲航空決定選擇使用波音 787-9 型號客機來替代並進行後續的航班營運。
根據歷史背景紀錄，波音 787-9 在 2026 年引領全球廣體客機的交付數量。隨著新機陸續交付，該型號的導入正加速四家航空公司旗下總計三款較舊機型的退役進程。

en.title: Qantas Set to End Airbus A380 Flights From Melbourne to Los Angeles on October 24
en.summary: According to a report by Simple Flying, Qantas is scheduled to operate its final Airbus A380 flight from Melbourne to Los Angeles on October 24, marking the end of the aircraft's deployment on the service as the airline opts for the Boeing 787-9 instead. Verified historical records show that the Boeing 787-9 is leading widebody aircraft deliveries in 2026, a trend that is accelerating the retirement of three older aircraft types across four airlines.
body: According to a report from Simple Flying, Australian carrier Qantas is scheduled to operate its final Airbus A380 service on the route between Melbourne and Los Angeles on October 24.
Following the conclusion of Airbus A380 flights on the Melbourne-Los Angeles sector, the airline is opting to replace the superjumbo with the Boeing 787-9 aircraft type instead.

Verified historical records indicate that the Boeing 787-9 is leading widebody aircraft deliveries in 2026. The steady arrival of the twinjet is accelerating the retirement of three older aircraft types across four different airlines.

zh.title: 灣流G700創洛杉磯至法恩堡飛行速度新紀錄
zh.summary: 灣流航太宣布其G700公務機在洛杉磯國際機場（FAB）至法恩堡機場的航線上創下新速度紀錄，以8小時27分鐘完成航程，比龐巴迪Global 8000於2026年7月19日創下的紀錄快了19分鐘。灣流聲稱該次飛行比龐巴迪快3.6%。
body: 灣流航太（Gulfstream）於2026年7月30日宣布，旗下G700公務機在洛杉磯國際機場至法恩堡機場的航線中創下新飛行速度紀錄。該機以8小時27分鐘完成了4,740海里的航程，成功刷新該航線的最快飛行時間。
此紀錄比加拿大龐巴迪（Bombardier）的Global 8000公務機於同年7月19日所創下的8小時46分鐘紀錄快了19分鐘。灣流聲稱其G700飛行速度比龐巴迪快3.6%。Global 8000於2025年12月投入服務，極速為0.95馬赫；而G700於2024年投入服務，極速則為0.935馬赫。

en.title: Gulfstream G700 Breaks Bombardier Speed Record from LAX (LAX) to Farnborough
en.summary: Gulfstream has announced that its G700 business jet set a new speed record between Los Angeles International Airport and Farnborough Airport (FAB), completing the flight in 8 hours and 27 minutes. This achievement surpasses the previous record set on July 19, 2026, by Bombardier's Global 8000, which recorded a flight time of 8 hours and 46 minutes. Gulfstream claims its G700 flight was 3.6% faster than Bombardier's trip. The G700 entered service in 2024 with a top speed of Mach 0.935, while the Global 8000 entered service in December 2025 and is capable of reaching Mach 0.95.
body: On July 30, 2026, Gulfstream announced that its G700 business jet set a new speed record between Los Angeles International Airport  and Farnborough Airport . The aircraft completed the 4,740-nautical-mile flight in 8 hours and 27 minutes.

This flight beat Bombardier's Global 8000 record of 8 hours and 46 minutes, set on July 19, 2026, by 19 minutes. Gulfstream claims the G700 was 3.6% faster than Bombardier's flight. The Global 8000 entered service in December 2025 with a top speed of Mach 0.95, while the G700 entered service in 2024 with a top speed of Mach 0.935.
